items.docs: List phishing simulation user events (observations) for the authenticated organization. Events track user interactions with phishing campaigns such as email opens, link clicks, data submissions, and reports. Includes joined user context (name, department, email) in each event. Supports filtering by campaign, action type, user attributes, and date range.
